page: Amazon Web Services r8id.12xlarge is a memory-optimized instance powered by an Intel Xeon 6975P-C processor. Built on the x86_64 architecture, it features 48 vCPUs across 24 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The instance is equipped with 384.0 GB of DDR5 memory operating at 7 GHz, providing a 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. Local storage is bundled as a 2850 GB NVMe SSD instance store volume, and network connectivity is supported by a 22 Gbps baseline bandwidth managed via the Nitro hypervisor.

Benchmark data indicates strong memory and processing capabilities. The instance achieves a read-only small block memory bandwidth of 3840.86 GB/sec and a large block read-only bandwidth of 192.31 GB/sec, both placing in the top 25% tier. CPU performance is highlighted by a Passmark CPU score of 69,124.82 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 19,680.0. In specialized workloads, the server demonstrates high efficiency, achieving 85.77 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks and 80.86 GB/sec in static web serving throughput. Text processing and image processing benchmarks register in the top 10% tier.

The hardware profile offers high resource density for memory-intensive applications, balancing high-speed DDR5 memory with local NVMe storage. While single-core and multi-core CPU stress tests perform in the average tier, the inclusion of Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) and AVX-512 instruction sets enhances cryptographic and vector processing efficiency. This makes the r8id.12xlarge highly suitable for large-scale database operations, in-memory caching systems like Redis, data-intensive ETL pipelines, and medium-scale LLM inference tasks.
description: The Amazon Web Services r8id.12xlarge is a memory-optimized instance featuring 48 vCPUs, 24 physical cores, and 384.0 GB of high-speed DDR5 memory. Powered by an Intel Xeon 6975P-C processor running at 3.9 GHz, this instance integrates 2850 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and operates on the Nitro hypervisor with a 22 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Benchmark results show strong performance, with memory read-only bandwidth reaching 3840.86 GB/sec and Redis SET operations exceeding 85 million operations per second. The CPU supports advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512 and AMX, which accelerate vector and matrix operations. This server is optimized for memory-intensive and storage-heavy workloads, making it highly suitable for enterprise database hosting, in-memory caching, and data processing pipelines.
